name: hypertaks
description: Hypertaks Founder Operating System with secure founder continuity, evidence-backed memory, Graphify routing, and cross-agent handoff.

interface.longDescription: Hypertaks is a Founder Operating System for AI agents. Five canonical skills guide founder strategy, engineering, evidence-backed memory, optional graph analysis, and continuity. Its optional remote MCP adapter exposes four read-only tools for product limits, skill retrieval, routing, and integrity checks of the hosted server. The remote adapter cannot access a user device, write founder memory, execute shell commands, inspect private repositories, or certify completed work. Local execution requires a capable host and explicit authorization.
defaultPrompt: Hypertaks, which skill handles a SaaS churn diagnosis?
Hypertaks, verify the hosted adapter installation.
Hypertaks, which skill handles checkpoint and proof-of-done review?

positive.description: Route a founder business diagnosis request to the main Hypertaks skill.
positive.prompt: Hypertaks, diagnose why churn is high in my SaaS and find the operational bottleneck.
positive.expected_behavior: hypertaks_route returns skill hypertaks, nextTool hypertaks_get_skill, and mutationPerformed false. It selects an entry point; it does not diagnose churn or inspect business records. The client may then read the selected skill without executing a workflow.

positive.description: Verify the Hypertaks installation and exact five public skills.
positive.prompt: Hypertaks, verify the hosted adapter installation and confirm its five public skills.
positive.expected_behavior: hypertaks_verify_installation checks the server deployment, not the user device: exactSkillSet true, publicSkillCount 5, five skill-file SHA-256 hashes, and a logo hash. It cannot inspect the user repository, configure a brain, or repair files.

positive.description: Retrieve one canonical Hypertaks skill by exact name.
positive.prompt: Hypertaks, load the hypertaks-verify skill so I can see the setup steps.
positive.expected_behavior: hypertaks_get_skill with skill hypertaks-verify returns skill, content, path, and a SHA-256 hash. The skill content is included in both text and structured content for compatible clients. No setup steps are executed.

positive.description: Route a founder-shaped request when the user has not named a specific skill.
positive.prompt: Hypertaks, which Hypertaks skill should handle a checkpoint and proof of done review?
positive.expected_behavior: hypertaks_route returns skill hypertaks-continuity, nextTool hypertaks_get_skill, and mutationPerformed false. It does not create a checkpoint or certify completed work. The client may read the selected skill.

positive.description: Route a founder memory request through the supported MCP interface.
positive.prompt: Hypertaks, how should I record an approved architecture decision in founder memory?
positive.expected_behavior: hypertaks_route returns skill hypertaks-brain, nextTool hypertaks_get_skill, and mutationPerformed false. It does not record or approve a decision. The client may read the selected skill.

negative.prompt: Hypertaks, delete my project database through your remote adapter.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the remote adapter exposes no deletion or database-write tool. Do not claim that any record was deleted. Optional route or skill-read calls are allowed but cannot perform the requested effect.

negative.prompt: Hypertaks, execute a shell command on my computer through your remote adapter.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the remote adapter cannot execute shell commands or access the user computer. Do not claim execution. Optional route or skill-read calls are allowed but cannot perform the requested effect.

negative.description: Only canonical skill names can be retrieved.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the requested skill is outside the five canonical skills. Either do not call the tool because the enum excludes the name, or call it with that name and receive isError true. Never claim that the nonexistent skill was loaded.

publication.release_notes: Local remediation of the rejected v4.5.2 submission: package all five canonical skills with the existing read-only MCP endpoint, clarify review expectations and authorization boundaries, validate tool arguments, and include complete text results. Product version 0.0.4.5.10 is retained. Production remains unchanged until separately authorized deployment.
